title: Isomorphism between finite extensions with depth two along the boundary
statement: Let $L$ be a locally Noetherian scheme and $U\subset L$ an open [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $r:F\to L$ and $p:E\to L$ be finite morphisms [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Suppose $\operatorname{depth}\mathcal O_{F,z}\geq2$ when $r(z)\notin U$, and $\operatorname{depth}\mathcal O_{E,z}\geq2$ when $p(z)\notin U$ [def-weil-pbc-depth]. Given an isomorphism $e:E\times_L U\cong F\times_L U$ over $U$, there exists an isomorphism $i:F\cong E$ over $L$, that is $p\circ i=r$. Neither morphism is required to be etale, and no depth assumption on $L$ is imposed. The conclusion asserts existence of an isomorphism over $L$, not a separate uniqueness clause.

source.place: Tag 0EY6 (https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0EY6), converse in the proof of (2); Tags 0AUK and 0E9I

proof.text: Invert the supplied open isomorphism e; its inverse is over U by the inverse identities and the supplied equation he. Apply morphism extension to e.inv with source F and to e.hom with source E, producing f:F -> E and g:E -> F over L with the specified restrictions.

The restriction of f followed by g is the identity because e.inv followed by e.hom is the identity. Equality detection with source F therefore gives f followed by g = id_F. Similarly source E gives g followed by f = id_E. These calculations use the inclusion equations delivered by extension and associativity.
Package f,g and the two inverse identities into a scheme isomorphism. The equation f followed by p = r is already delivered by extension.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0EY6 converse of (2), assembled by extending both open inverse maps and detecting both inverse identities on the open

mathlib_searches.query: finite morphisms uniquely determined by restriction to an open with source stalk depth at least two
Two finite morphisms of locally Noetherian schemes with depth at least two above the complement of an open are isomorphic if their restrictions over that open are isomorphic

lean.statement:
theorem iso_of_finite_depth_two_extensions
    {L : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (U : L.Opens)
    {F E : Scheme.{u}} (r : F ⟶ L) (p : E ⟶ L) [IsFinite r] [IsFinite p]
    (hF : ∀ z : F, r z ∉ U →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := F.presheaf.stalk z) (F.presheaf.stalk z))
    (hE : ∀ z : E, p z ∉ U →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := E.presheaf.stalk z) (E.presheaf.stalk z))
    (e : (p ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme ≅ (r ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme)
    (he : e.hom ≫ r ∣_ U = p ∣_ U) :
    ∃ i : F ≅ E, i.hom ≫ p = r
